_readme: Exceptions for the coverage gates C6, C7 and C8.
Every entry needs a reason and the gate refuses an empty one — the point of
this file is that a gap is a sentence somebody wrote, not a silent skip.
An entry absent from the current static inventory is stale; one already
addressed by a matching declaration is redundant. Both fail C9.
An exception records a current static gap and a specific limitation; it
does not prove that a runtime behavior is impossible to test.

C8.reason: Global static gap: source declares an internal-error 500, but the current collection and AI tests do not assert a controlled 500 response. Expected-input tests reject unexpected 500s; that is a different guarantee and does not exercise internal-error handling. A controlled 500 test remains possible future work.
